easyPrerequisites: Blossom-Clad Werewolf and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
